r7_paired.caveat: ClamAV healthy historical Linux era, frozen versions recorded per engine. General stored verdicts and reconstructed routed OR signals are distinct. Pair latency includes both ML profiles; not current product HTTP latency. Separate memory maxima must not be summed.

unobserved_role_inventory.caveat: Role counts from historical audited metadata; not a newly verified final cohort. Untouched does not establish labels, independence, source diversity or scoring authorization.

source_unknown_pilot.timing_limitations: Cache disabled; sequential new workers; includes unpack and startup; RSS excludes descendants/clamd. Use cgroup evidence for aggregate memory. Engine timing intervals overlap.

source_unknown_expansion.timing_limitations: Cache disabled; sequential new workers; includes startup, excludes unpack; RSS excludes descendants/clamd. Use cgroup evidence for aggregate memory. Engine timing intervals overlap.

limitations: Labels are historical vendor corroboration, not curated ground truth
No threshold tuning on this test archive
Frozen 4 SHA256 / 2 fuzzy references and 2 YARA rules have narrow coverage

legacy_panels_not_pooled.caveat: Overlapping/subset and different-era panels; never sum their sample counts or pool confusion matrices.

prospective_final_design: Reserve source/project/release groups and malicious family/source components disjoint from FIT and development.
Document raw integrity, authorized provenance and independent label adjudication; disputed labels remain unknown.
Audit exact and available near-duplicate links plus training membership residuals before admission.
Use fresh admitted validation for any selection; freeze final manifest and scoring plan before final execution.
Report engine/fusion alert and malicious-only counts, coverage/errors, fixed-threshold confusion and family/source strata.
Keep malware in the existing isolated Ubuntu VM; any new raw final scoring requires root admission/authorization audit.
